newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen trading around current levels.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen trading around current levels.

text.p: Taiwan share prices are expected to consolidate at around current levels on Wednesday amid caution after two successive days of rebounds, brokers said.
On Tuesday, the stock index ended up 8.75 points at 8,430.62. A 8,350-8,500 range was seen for Wednesday.
Foreign institutions becoming net buyers in the past two days should help support sentiment, brokers said.

They said the 8,500-point level remains short-term resistance because investors still remember well the central bank's and the Securities and Exchange Commission's warnings in previous market rallies around this level.
"Investors may be bargain hunting shares when seeing any price falls, but they would be cautious about pushing prices yet higher," said National Securities manager Allen Huang.
Brokers said sectors with sound profit performance or outlook still may attract buying.
"We now hope that the previous liquidity-driven rally can turn into an earnings-driven rally," Huang said.

Loose liquidity was widely seen as the main trigger for previous rallies, and the central bank in recent weeks had continued issuing negotiable certificates of deposit to mop up excess money. -- James Peng (5080815)
